public_definitions: The task requires comparing the 2020 reported values for U.S. and Rest of the World from the dashboard.
The dashboard is the only source for determining which region has the larger 2020 value.
The action to take is to open the follow-up record for the region with the larger 2020 value.
The three options are: Open U.S. record, Open Rest of the World record, or Send to archive.
uncertain: The exact visual positioning of the 2020 data points relative to other years is consistent with the labeled values, but the chart does not provide a scale or unit for the vertical axis, so the relative heights are interpreted as proportional to the labeled values.
